description: This file contains API utility functions for a frontend dashboard, including functions to resolve API base URLs, fetch JSON data from endpoints, and retrieve module overviews and metrics for a data management dashboard.

methods.name: resolveBase
methods.description: Resolves a reliable API base URL using environment variables, heuristics, or fallback to localhost.

methods.name: fetchJson
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from a given URL with optional credentials, handling organization ID and error cases.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Normalizes various data shapes into an array.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Fetches a modules overview for the dashboard, trying multiple endpoints or deriving minimal data.

methods.name: getOverviewMetrics
methods.description: Fetches consolidated total metrics for the dashboard overview.
